# Kevin Yi (@yikaus)

> Principal Engineer and DevOps Lead at NAB in Melbourne, Australia — building secure, automated cloud platforms and exploring how agentic AI reshapes enterprise engineering and operations.

## Profile
- **Name:** Kevin Yi
- **Handle:** yikaus
- **Role:** Principal Engineer & DevOps Lead at NAB
- **Location:** Melbourne, Australia
- **Motto:** Set of guardrails. Many ways.
- **Machine-readable YAML:** https://yikaus.github.io/kevin.yaml

## Focus Areas
- **Cloud & Platform Engineering:** Enterprise cloud migrations (GCP & AWS), secure landing zones, and internal developer platforms at banking scale.
- **DevOps & CI/CD Strategy:** Resilient delivery pipelines, infrastructure-as-code guardrails, and modern edge/container workflows.
- **Agentic AI & Engineering Economics:** Modeling enterprise AI TCO (L1 assistants to L4 agentic systems) and terminal-native, agent-first workflows.

## Featured Projects
- **Intelligence Economics (`aitco`):** Enterprise agentic AI TCO & 5-year forecast simulator exploring the "Inference Paradox" (TypeScript, WebMCP, Cloudflare Workers). Live: https://yikaus.github.io/aitco/ | Repo: https://github.com/yikaus/aitco
- **MiniSocial (`minit`):** Mobile-first microblog on one Cloudflare Worker (React/Vite, Hono, Better Auth on D1, R2, KV, Queues). Live: https://minisocial.yikaus.workers.dev | Repo: https://github.com/yikaus/minit
- **Network Fingerprint:** Lightweight Cloudflare Worker generating downloadable SVG fingerprint art from visitor IP and local browser ID. Repo: https://github.com/yikaus/network-fingerprint
- **k3s-cicd:** Local self-hosted CI/CD stack running Drone CI and Gitea on k3d/k3s. Repo: https://github.com/yikaus/k3s-cicd
- **Cloud & Container Toolkit:** `docker-alpine-bash`, `vultrcli`, and `hashistack` (Consul/Nomad/Vault on AWS). Repos: https://github.com/yikaus
- **kmart-at (ToyOps):** PS3 Bluetooth-controlled ESP32 robot. Repo: https://github.com/yikaus/kmart-at
